wiki_catalogs.name: Getting Started
wiki_catalogs.prompt: Create comprehensive getting started content for the POS System. Explain the project purpose as a Point of Sale system with inventory management, cashier operations, and administrative features. Document installation requirements including Node.js, database setup, and system dependencies. Provide step-by-step installation instructions covering environment setup, dependency installation, database initialization, and first-time configuration. Include basic usage examples showing how to start the application, navigate the interface, and perform common tasks like creating products, processing sales, and managing inventory. Address initial configuration options, default credentials, and troubleshooting common setup issues. Make content accessible to beginners while providing clear next steps for deeper exploration.

wiki_catalogs.name: Core Architecture
wiki_catalogs.prompt: Create comprehensive architectural documentation for the POS System's core architecture. Explain the three-tier desktop application design using Electron as the main process, React SPA frontend, and Express backend server. Document the component hierarchy including Admin, Cashier, and Clerk modules with their respective layouts and navigation patterns. Detail the separation of concerns between UI components, business logic, and data access layers. Explain how Electron bridges the desktop environment with the web-based application. Include diagrams showing the relationship between main process, renderer processes, and background services. Document the module organization pattern used across different user roles and their specific interfaces.

wiki_catalogs.name: Authentication System
wiki_catalogs.prompt: Create comprehensive documentation for the POS System's authentication system. Document both password-based authentication and Clerk integration approaches. Explain the AuthContext implementation for state management, token handling, and session persistence. Detail the authenticate middleware for server-side validation and protection of API routes. Include examples of login flows, logout mechanisms, and error handling. Document JWT token structure, expiration handling, and refresh strategies. Address security considerations including password hashing, CSRF protection, and secure storage practices. Provide guidance on implementing custom authentication providers and integrating with external identity services.

wiki_catalogs.name: Cashier Interface
wiki_catalogs.prompt: Create comprehensive content for the Cashier Interface component. Explain the main cashier page layout, navigation structure, and state management between cart and payment panels. Document how the Cashier.tsx orchestrates the entire POS workflow including product scanning, cart management, and payment processing. Detail the responsive design patterns used for different screen sizes and touch interactions. Include examples of how to customize the interface layout, add new product categories, and integrate with barcode scanners. Address performance optimization techniques for handling large product catalogs and real-time inventory updates.

wiki_catalogs.name: Return Workflow and Processing
wiki_catalogs.prompt: Create comprehensive content for the return workflow and processing system. Explain the complete return lifecycle from initiation at POS to final completion. Document the ReturnsPanel component functionality including item selection, quantity validation, and refund calculation. Detail the return validation rules implemented in validateReturn.ts including product eligibility, time limits, and condition checks. Cover the API endpoints for creating returns, processing refunds, and updating return status. Include practical examples of handling different return scenarios: full returns, partial returns, exchanges, and damaged goods. Document error handling, validation messages, and user feedback patterns. Address integration with inventory management for stock restoration and sales record updates.

wiki_catalogs.name: Product Catalog Management
wiki_catalogs.prompt: Create detailed documentation for the Product Catalog Management system. Document the complete product lifecycle from creation to deactivation, including product attributes, pricing, barcode management, and category organization. Explain the relationship between products, categories, suppliers, and units of measure. Detail the CRUD operations for products and categories, bulk import/export capabilities, and search/filter functionality. Include examples of product data models, validation rules, and business constraints. Document barcode generation and scanning integration, product variants support, and tax configuration per product type.

wiki_catalogs.name: Architecture Overview
wiki_catalogs.prompt: Create architectural documentation for the POS System. Describe the high-level design as a desktop Electron application with React frontend and Express backend. Document the three-tier architecture: Electron main process handling desktop integration, React client application for user interface, and Node.js server for business logic and API endpoints. Explain component interactions between the UI layer, business logic layer, and data persistence layer. Detail the technology stack including React, TypeScript, Electron, Express, and SQLite. Document the build system using Vite and the development workflow. Include system context diagrams showing data flow between components, authentication flow, and real-time communication patterns. Address security considerations, performance optimization strategies, and scalability constraints.

wiki_catalogs.name: Technology Stack
wiki_catalogs.prompt: Create detailed technology stack documentation for the POS System. Document the complete technology ecosystem including React 18 with TypeScript for the frontend, Electron for desktop packaging, Express.js for the backend API, and SQLite for data persistence. Explain the build system configuration using Vite for development and production builds. Detail the UI component library setup with shadcn/ui and Tailwind CSS for styling. Document code quality tools including Prettier for formatting and ESLint for linting. Include version compatibility matrices, dependency management strategies, and development environment setup requirements. Address browser compatibility considerations and mobile responsiveness approaches.

wiki_catalogs.name: Role Definitions
wiki_catalogs.prompt: Develop detailed documentation for the three primary user roles in the POS System: Admin, Cashier, and Clerk. Document the specific responsibilities, access levels, and operational scope for each role. Explain the database schema for user roles and how they are stored and managed. Detail the role hierarchy and inheritance patterns if applicable. Include examples of role-specific UI layouts, navigation menus, and feature availability. Document the migration process for updating user roles and bulk role assignment. Address role-based data filtering and record-level permissions where implemented. Provide guidance on creating role-specific dashboards and workflows.

wiki_catalogs.name: Cart Management System
wiki_catalogs.prompt: Develop detailed content for the Cart Management System. Thoroughly explain the CartPanel component implementation including product addition/removal, quantity adjustments, and price calculations. Document the cart state management using React hooks and context providers. Detail the integration with products API for real-time inventory validation and pricing. Include code examples showing how to implement bulk operations, apply discounts, and handle out-of-stock scenarios. Explain the money utility functions for currency formatting and calculations. Address error handling for invalid quantities, insufficient stock, and network failures during cart operations.

wiki_catalogs.name: Return Approval System
wiki_catalogs.prompt: Develop detailed content for the return approval system. Thoroughly explain the PendingReturnsPanel component for managing approval queues and the approval workflow process. Document the database schema for tracking return statuses, approval hierarchies, and audit trails. Detail the approval criteria, manager permissions, and escalation procedures. Include examples of approving, rejecting, and requesting additional information for returns. Document notification mechanisms for pending approvals and status updates. Address edge cases like high-value returns requiring senior approval, automated approvals for eligible transactions, and approval deadline management. Explain the integration with user roles and permission systems for access control.

wiki_catalogs.name: Stock Operations
wiki_catalogs.prompt: Develop comprehensive documentation for Stock Operations covering stock-in processes, stock adjustments, and inventory corrections. Detail the stock-in workflow for receiving new inventory from suppliers, including partial deliveries, batch tracking, and quality checks. Document stock adjustment procedures for corrections, damages, losses, and transfers between locations. Explain the dual-interface approach where Clerks perform operational tasks while Admins oversee strategic decisions. Include examples of stock movement tracking, audit trails, and approval workflows. Address integration with external processing for commodity-based products and automated stock level calculations.

wiki_catalogs.name: User Roles and Permissions
wiki_catalogs.prompt: Create comprehensive documentation for the POS System's role-based access control system. Document the three primary user roles: Admin (full system access), Cashier (POS operations and limited inventory management), and Clerk (inventory and stock management). Explain authentication mechanisms including password-based login and Clerk integration. Detail permission matrices showing what each role can access across different modules. Document the middleware implementation for route protection and role validation. Include examples of protected routes, custom hooks for authorization checks, and dynamic UI rendering based on user roles. Address password lifecycle management, session handling, and security best practices. Provide guidance on adding new roles or modifying existing permissions.

wiki_catalogs.name: System Design Patterns
wiki_catalogs.prompt: Create comprehensive documentation for system design patterns implemented in the POS System. Document the context-based state management pattern using React Context for authentication and theme management. Explain the middleware pattern for request authentication and authorization on the server side. Detail the hook composition pattern for reusable logic like useComposition and useMobile. Document the protected route pattern for role-based access control. Include the audit logging pattern for tracking system activities. Explain error boundary implementation for graceful error handling. Document the service layer pattern for API communication and data abstraction. Address caching strategies, event-driven patterns, and reactive programming approaches used throughout the application.

wiki_catalogs.name: Permission Management
wiki_catalogs.prompt: Create detailed documentation for the permission management system in the POS System. Document the requireRole middleware implementation for route protection and authorization checks. Explain the ProtectedRoute component for client-side route guarding based on user roles. Detail the useComposition hook for managing complex permission logic and conditional rendering. Document the permission utility functions for checking user capabilities at runtime. Include examples of implementing role-based UI components, dynamic menu generation, and feature toggles. Address permission caching strategies and performance optimization. Provide guidance on adding new permissions, testing authorization logic, and debugging permission issues.

wiki_catalogs.name: Payment Processing
wiki_catalogs.prompt: Create comprehensive content for the Payment Processing system. Explain the PaymentPanel component that handles various payment methods including cash, card, and digital payments. Document the complete sales transaction lifecycle from payment initiation to receipt generation. Detail the server-side sales API endpoints for processing transactions, validating payments, and updating inventory. Include examples of implementing custom payment methods, handling payment failures, and managing partial payments. Document the receipt generation utilities for formatting and printing receipts. Address security considerations for payment data handling, transaction validation, and audit logging.

wiki_catalogs.name: Admin Returns Management
wiki_catalogs.prompt: Create detailed documentation for the admin returns management interface. Explain the Returns page functionality including return filtering, search capabilities, and bulk operations. Document the reporting features for return analytics, trends analysis, and performance metrics. Detail the audit logging system for compliance and investigation purposes. Include examples of managing return policies, configuring approval thresholds, and monitoring return rates by product or category. Document export capabilities for accounting and reconciliation processes. Address administrative tasks like resolving disputes, handling exceptions, and generating compliance reports. Explain integration with other admin modules for comprehensive oversight.

wiki_catalogs.name: Inventory Monitoring & Alerts
wiki_catalogs.prompt: Create detailed documentation for Inventory Monitoring and Alerting systems. Document low-stock detection algorithms, threshold configurations, and automated reorder alerts. Explain the monitoring dashboard for real-time inventory status, stock level visualization, and alert management. Detail the integration with external processing for commodity-based products and automatic stock deductions. Include examples of alert customization, notification channels, and escalation procedures. Document the relationship between inventory levels, sales velocity, and reorder point calculations. Address performance considerations for large inventories and real-time updates.

wiki_catalogs.name: Point of Sale Module
wiki_catalogs.prompt: Develop detailed content for the Point of Sale module. Thoroughly explain the cashier interface implementation, cart management system, and payment processing workflows. Document the CartPanel component for product selection and quantity management, PaymentPanel for handling various payment methods, and the main Cashier page layout. Detail the sales transaction lifecycle from product scanning to receipt generation. Include code examples showing how to add items to cart, apply discounts, process payments, and generate receipts. Document the money utility functions for currency calculations and receipt formatting utilities. Address error handling for failed transactions, inventory validation, and real-time stock updates. Explain integration with barcode scanners and receipt printers.

wiki_catalogs.name: Data Flow and Communication
wiki_catalogs.prompt: Create detailed documentation for data flow and communication patterns in the POS System. Document the client-server communication using RESTful APIs with proper error handling and retry mechanisms. Explain WebSocket implementation for real-time features like notifications and live updates. Detail the authentication flow from login through token management to session handling. Document the data synchronization strategy between local storage and remote database. Explain the event-driven communication between different modules and components. Include diagrams showing request/response cycles, WebSocket message flows, and state synchronization patterns. Address data validation, transformation pipelines, and error propagation strategies throughout the communication layers.

wiki_catalogs.name: Receipt Generation and Printing
wiki_catalogs.prompt: Develop detailed content for the Receipt Generation and Printing functionality. Explain the receipt.ts utility functions for creating formatted receipt data structures and generating printable formats. Document the integration with thermal printers and PDF generation for digital receipts. Detail the receipt template system for customizing layouts, adding company logos, and including tax information. Include examples of implementing multi-language receipt support, adding promotional messages, and handling receipt voiding. Address printer connectivity issues, paper size compatibility, and fallback mechanisms for failed print jobs. Document the return receipt printer integration for processing returns and refunds.

wiki_catalogs.name: Return Data Models and Schema
wiki_catalogs.prompt: Develop comprehensive data model documentation for the returns system. Detail the return table structure, field definitions, and relationships with sales and products tables. Document the return number generation algorithm and format specifications. Explain data validation rules, constraints, and referential integrity requirements. Include examples of return records, status transitions, and audit trail entries. Document the database indexes for performance optimization and query patterns commonly used. Address data retention policies, archival strategies, and backup considerations. Explain migration procedures for schema changes and data consistency maintenance.

wiki_catalogs.name: Inventory Management
wiki_catalogs.prompt: Create comprehensive documentation for the Inventory Management system. Detail the dual-interface approach with Admin and Clerk roles having different capabilities. Document product catalog management, stock tracking, and inventory adjustments. Explain the stock-in workflow for receiving new inventory, stock adjustment processes for corrections, and low-stock alerting system. Include examples of CRUD operations for products, bulk inventory updates, and barcode management. Document the relationship between products, categories, suppliers, and units of measure. Address inventory valuation methods, stock reconciliation processes, and audit trail maintenance. Cover integration with external processing for commodity-based products and automated reorder alerts.

wiki_catalogs.name: Sales API Integration
wiki_catalogs.prompt: Create comprehensive content for the Sales API Integration layer. Document the RESTful API endpoints for sales transactions including POST /api/sales for creating transactions, GET /api/sales for retrieving history, and PUT /api/sales/:id for modifications. Detail the request/response schemas, authentication requirements, and error handling patterns. Explain the integration with inventory API for automatic stock deduction and the audit logging system for transaction tracking. Include examples of implementing client-side API calls with proper error handling and retry logic. Document the WebSocket integration for real-time inventory updates and notification systems. Address rate limiting, input validation, and security measures for protecting sales data.

wiki_catalogs.name: Returns Processing
wiki_catalogs.prompt: Develop detailed content for the Returns Processing system. Thoroughly explain the return workflow from initiation through approval and completion. Document the ReturnsPanel component for processing returns at the POS, PendingReturnsPanel for managing approval queues, and the admin Returns page for oversight. Detail the return validation rules, refund calculation logic, and inventory restoration processes. Include examples of creating returns, applying partial refunds, and handling exchanges. Document the return number generation system, audit logging for compliance, and integration with sales records. Address edge cases like expired returns, partial returns, and multi-item transactions. Explain the approval workflow and notification system for pending returns.

wiki_catalogs.name: Admin Dashboard
wiki_catalogs.prompt: Create comprehensive documentation for the Admin Dashboard system. Detail the dashboard layout structure, navigation components, and role-based access controls. Document key administrative pages including Sales monitoring, Reports generation, User management, and System settings. Explain the real-time dashboard metrics, sales analytics, and performance indicators. Include examples of generating reports, managing user accounts, and configuring system parameters. Document the data visualization components, export functionality, and filtering capabilities. Address security considerations for administrative functions, audit logging, and system health monitoring. Cover customization options for dashboard layouts and report templates.

wiki_catalogs.name: API Reference
wiki_catalogs.prompt: Create comprehensive API documentation for all REST endpoints. Document HTTP methods, URL patterns, request/response schemas, and authentication requirements for each endpoint. Include detailed specifications for authentication APIs, sales transaction endpoints, inventory management operations, product CRUD operations, user management functions, and return processing APIs. Provide example requests and responses with proper status codes and error formats. Document WebSocket endpoints for real-time notifications and live updates. Include rate limiting information, versioning strategy, and deprecation policies. Address security considerations, input validation, and error handling patterns. Provide client integration examples and SDK usage guidelines.

wiki_catalogs.name: Database Schema
wiki_catalogs.prompt: Create comprehensive data model documentation for the POS System database schema. Detail entity relationships, field definitions, and data types for all tables including users, products, sales, inventory, returns, and audit logs. Document primary/foreign keys, indexes, and constraints that ensure data integrity. Explain data validation rules enforced at the database level and business rules implemented through triggers. Include ER diagrams showing table relationships and data flow patterns. Document data migration strategies, backup procedures, and recovery processes. Address performance considerations including query optimization, indexing strategies, and data partitioning. Specify data retention policies, archival procedures, and compliance requirements for financial data.

wiki_catalogs.name: UI Components
wiki_catalogs.prompt: Create detailed documentation for reusable UI components. Document the component library built with Radix UI primitives and Tailwind CSS styling. Detail component props, events, slots, and customization options for buttons, cards, dialogs, forms, and data tables. Include usage examples with code snippets demonstrating common patterns and advanced configurations. Provide guidelines for responsive design implementation, accessibility compliance, and theme customization. Document component composition patterns, state management approaches, and integration with form libraries. Address cross-browser compatibility considerations, performance optimization techniques, and testing strategies. Include guidelines for extending existing components and creating new custom components following established patterns.

wiki_catalogs.name: Deployment Guide
wiki_catalogs.prompt: Create comprehensive deployment documentation for the POS System. Detail production build processes, environment configuration, and deployment strategies for both development and production environments. Document Electron packaging for desktop distribution, including code signing, auto-updater configuration, and installer creation. Explain server deployment options, database setup, and environment variable configuration. Include Docker containerization guides, CI/CD pipeline setup, and automated testing procedures. Address security hardening measures, SSL certificate configuration, and firewall requirements. Document backup and disaster recovery procedures, monitoring setup, and log management. Provide troubleshooting guides for common deployment issues and performance tuning recommendations.

wiki_catalogs.name: Troubleshooting & FAQ
wiki_catalogs.prompt: Create comprehensive troubleshooting documentation addressing common issues and their solutions. Document error handling patterns, debugging techniques, and diagnostic tools available in the system. Include frequently asked questions about installation problems, runtime errors, performance issues, and integration challenges. Provide step-by-step guides for resolving database connection issues, authentication problems, and UI rendering errors. Document log analysis techniques, error boundary usage, and debugging workflows for both frontend and backend components. Address browser compatibility issues, mobile device considerations, and printer configuration problems. Include performance profiling guides, memory leak detection, and optimization strategies. Provide contact information for support and community resources for additional help.
